writeup: Woot has the new Creative Co-Op three-piece enameled metal square planter set (model DG1638, UPC 191009815488) for $36.99. The nested squares measure 7.25, 6.25, and 5.25 inches and fit 6-inch, 5-inch, and 4-inch pots. Overstock lists the same Storied Home / Creative Co-Op DG1638 trio as item 47044355 for $87.99 and shows it in stock with no promo code.
